title: India and Indonesia Sign $630M BrahMos Missile Deal During Modi Visit
detail: During Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi's July 6–8 visit to Jakarta, Indonesia's Defense Ministry finalized a contract with BrahMos Aerospace for the land-based coastal-defense variant of the supersonic BrahMos cruise missile, alongside a cooperation pact between Bharat Dynamics Ltd. and Indonesian firm Republikorp for Astra air-to-air missiles. The package is valued at roughly $630 million and makes Indonesia the third Southeast Asian buyer of BrahMos after Vietnam and the Philippines, bolstering Jakarta's maritime deterrence capability. The visit also saw PT PAL Surabaya begin fabrication of Scorpene-class submarines, a milestone for Indonesia's domestic defense industry.
